description:
Convenient Folding Design: The scooter features a foldable body, making it easy to store at home, in your car trunk, or take with you while traveling.
Safety and Stability: Supports a weight capacity of 265 lbs, ensuring a safe ride for users of various body types. Sturdy frame construction and thickened shock-absorbing tires provide excellent stability, even on uneven terrain. Ideal for seniors, individuals with limited mobility, or anyone needing a reliable outdoor travel solution.
180W Powerful Motor: Equipped with a high-performance, energy-efficient motor, offering a range of up to 15 miles on a single charge. Perfect for grocery shopping, park strolls, or short trips. Maximum speed of 3.7 MPH and a strong climbing ability, handling slopes up to 15°, suitable for various terrains like community roads, sidewalks, and inclines.
Enhanced Safety Features: Bright front LED headlights ensure clear visibility in low-light or nighttime conditions. Anti-collision bumpers provide extra protection in case of accidental impacts, reducing the risk of damage. Equipped with anti-slip footrests and rear anti-tip wheels for added safety.
Comfort and Adjustability: Soft, breathable seat cushion for long-lasting comfort. Adjustable seat height, 360° rotating seat, and customizable armrest height and width for easy entry, exit, and personalized comfort. Includes a front basket for storage and an intuitive control panel for effortless operation. Features an intelligent electromagnetic brake system (auto-brake when released) and a smooth transition between electric and manual modes.

Convenient Folding Design: Foldable Body: Easy to store at home, in car trunks, or take while traveling. Folded Dimensions: 39.8"D x 19.1"H, making it highly portable.
